candidate_relations.reason: The histology supports malakoplakia, but the benchmark specifically requires the cutaneous form.
Calcinosis cutis does not describe the histiocytic proliferation with Michaelis-Gutmann bodies and E. coli culture characteristic of cutaneous malakoplakia.
In this clinical context, malakoplakia of the inguinal lesions identifies the benchmark diagnosis and its anatomic cutaneous presentation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cutaneous malakoplakia localized to the inguinal region
